svg.title: Mixture of experts: selective computation
svg.desc: A token representation enters a router. The router selects two of four example experts. Only those experts process this token, and a weighted combination merges their outputs. Idle experts remain part of the model. This illustrates one sparse MoE layer, not the exact Mistral Large 4 architecture.
svg.text: Simplified sparse MoE layer · selection can change for the next token
